description: Platform-agnostic navigation graph. Every surface is an equal **view** — full screen, sheet, sidebar, popover is a downstream rendering choice, not a structural one. States are views; transitions are navigation gestures that move the user between views. The concept actions performable *within* a view are documented in `meta.actions` — they are not transitions because they do not move the user. See doc02.02.01.

MapOverview.description: The everything view. Default landing surface. Shows pins for every Collection Entry in every visible Collection, colored by Collection appearance and styled by visited/unvisited state. The surface has two entry modes, determined by how the user arrived: the default browse mode (the landing surface), and an add-to-collection mode entered from CollectionDetail's TAP_ADD_ENTRY, in which a Collection is held as entry context (`collection-context`). The map, pins, and search are identical in both modes — add-to-collection mode only adds a status bar naming the target Collection and routes every Location the user opens back to that one Collection. Mode is a parameterized entry context, not a separate surface. See doc01.03 §4.

TAP_PIN.label: Inspect a pin
TAP_PIN.description: User taps a pin to inspect that Location. The focus gesture is MapOverview.selectPin (see meta.actions); navigation follows. A pin is a Location, which may appear in several Collections — LocationDetail fans out to those Collection Entries rather than assuming one.

TAP_COLLECTIONS_BUTTON.label: Browse Collections
TAP_COLLECTIONS_BUTTON.description: User opens the list of Collections to manage them.

DROP_PIN.label: Drop a pin
DROP_PIN.description: User long-presses a spot on the map to place a point. This produces an uncommitted candidate — not yet a Location — and opens LocationDraft over the map. Starts the Location-first flow from doc01.02 §3. The long-press gesture on the map is the only trigger; there is no dedicated drop-pin button.

PICK_SEARCH_RESULT.label: Pick a search result
PICK_SEARCH_RESULT.description: User types into the map's search field (Location.resolve, see meta.actions), then picks one candidate from the result list. The picked candidate opens in LocationDraft for inspection before it is committed.

TAP_SETTINGS.label: Open Settings
TAP_SETTINGS.description: User opens settings (providers, BYOK keys, sync target).

CANCEL_ADD.label: Cancel adding
CANCEL_ADD.description: Live only in add-to-collection mode (guard: `collection-context` is set). User abandons the add-to-collection flow from the status bar; return to the originating CollectionDetail without adding a Collection Entry.

LocationDetail.description: One Location, reached by tapping a pin. Shows the Location plus every Collection Entry that references it across the user's Collections. Entry point for adding this Location to another Collection, or opening one of its existing Collection Entries. See doc01.03 §2.

TAP_ADD_TO_COLLECTION.label: Add to a Collection
TAP_ADD_TO_COLLECTION.description: User adds this already-resolved Location to a Collection (Location-first flow). AddLocationToCollection picks which Collection.

TAP_ENTRY.label: Open a Collection Entry
TAP_ENTRY.description: User opens one of the Collection Entries that reference this Location, to inspect its Review in that Collection's context.

CollectionList.description: Manage the user's Collections. Create new ones, open existing ones, import external lists.

TAP_COLLECTION.label: Open a Collection
TAP_COLLECTION.description: User opens a Collection to see its Collection Entries.

TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.label: New Collection
TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.description: User starts a new Collection (Collection.create). Opens the CollectionEditor to set its metadata and author the Review template before any Collection Entries can be added.

TAP_IMPORT.label: Import a list
TAP_IMPORT.description: User imports an external collection (KML, GeoJSON, RTP bundle, third-party share URL).

CollectionDetail.description: One Collection: its Collection Entries shown as either a map or a list projection (toggleable in place — projection is a view-internal mode, not a separate view). Entry point for adding/removing Collection Entries, editing the template, and exporting/sharing.

TAP_TOGGLE_PROJECTION.description: User switches between the map and list projection of this Collection. Self-transition — same view, different in-place rendering.

TAP_ENTRY.label: Open a Collection Entry
TAP_ENTRY.description: User opens a single Collection Entry to inspect its Location and Review.

TAP_ADD_ENTRY.label: Add a Collection Entry
TAP_ADD_ENTRY.description: User starts the Collection-first add flow. This enters MapOverview in add-to-collection mode: the Collection is held as entry context (`collection-context`). The map, pins, and search are unchanged; a status bar names the target Collection. Any Location the user opens — by tapping a pin, dropping a pin, or picking a search result — carries the context through LocationDraft into AddLocationToCollection, where the originating Collection is pre-selected, so PICK_COLLECTION confirms rather than chooses. CANCEL_ADD from the status bar abandons the flow back here.

TAP_EDIT_TEMPLATE.label: Edit the Collection
TAP_EDIT_TEMPLATE.description: User opens the CollectionEditor for this Collection — its metadata and its Review template (Review.editTemplate).

CollectionEntryDetail.description: One Collection Entry — the (Location, Review) pair. Read-mostly view; mutation goes through ReviewForm. Hosts the 'open externally' handoff to Google Maps / Apple Maps / etc.

TAP_EDIT_REVIEW.label: Edit the Review
TAP_EDIT_REVIEW.description: User opens the form to edit the Review for this Collection Entry (Review.edit).

TAP_REMOVE_ENTRY.label: Remove the Collection Entry
TAP_REMOVE_ENTRY.description: User removes this Collection Entry from the Collection (Collection.removeEntry). Does not delete the Location — it may exist in other Collections.

VIEW_COLLECTION.label: View the Collection
VIEW_COLLECTION.description: User opens the Collection that owns this Entry. Useful when the Entry was reached from a map pin rather than from CollectionDetail — it navigates to the owning Collection explicitly rather than following the back stack, which BACK does.

BACK.description: Return to the owning Collection. (CollectionEntryDetail is also reachable from MapOverview; static BACK targets the Collection context — true back-stack is runtime history. See doc02.02.01.)

ReviewForm.description: Author or edit a Review instance against the Collection's template. Filling, clearing, and submitting fields are in-view concept actions (meta.actions); only SUBMIT and CANCEL move the user.

SUBMIT.label: Save the Review
SUBMIT.description: User commits the Review (Review.submit). The Collection Entry is saved; navigate to its CollectionEntryDetail.

CANCEL.description: User cancels without saving; the draft is discarded. (Reachable from AddLocationToCollection and CollectionEntryDetail; static CANCEL targets the Collection context.)

CollectionEditor.description: Author or edit a Collection — its metadata (name, description, appearance) and its Review template, the schema governing every Review in this Collection. Edit name and description, pick the appearance, add/remove/reorder template fields and pick field types (score, enum, boolean, date, power-ranking, text), adopt a built-in template as a starting point. Collection metadata is editable only here, not on CollectionDetail.

DONE.label: Finish editing
DONE.description: Collection metadata and template authored or edited; continue into the Collection.

LocationDraft.description: A candidate Location not yet committed — a point dropped on the map or a search result picked from MapOverview. Shows the coordinates and offers nearby resolution candidates (Location.resolveNearby). The user keeps the coordinates as-is (Location.dropPin commits a manual Location) or adopts a resolved candidate. Rendered as a sheet over the map — the map stays visible — which is a downstream choice (see doc02.02.01). See doc01.03 §2.

ADD_TO_COLLECTION.label: Add to a Collection
ADD_TO_COLLECTION.description: User commits the candidate — keeping the coordinates as a manual Location, or having adopted a resolved one — and proceeds to pick which Collection to add it to.

CLOSE.description: Discard the candidate; return to the everything view.

AddLocationToCollection.description: Location-first flow: a Location is already chosen (dropped pin, shared link, etc.). User picks which Collection to add it to. When reached in MapOverview's add-to-collection mode, the originating Collection is pre-selected from the entry context and PICK_COLLECTION confirms it rather than choosing.

PICK_COLLECTION.label: Pick a Collection
PICK_COLLECTION.description: User picks a Collection (Location.addToCollection); advance to fill out the Review.

TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.label: New Collection
TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.description: None of the existing Collections fit; create a new one (Collection.create) in the CollectionEditor.

CLOSE.description: Cancel; return to the everything view.

ImportFlow.description: Import an external collection. Stub — concrete steps (source picker, schema mapping, preview, confirm) will be detailed when the import view is unfolded.

DONE.label: Finish the import
DONE.description: Import committed; return to the refreshed Collection list.

Settings.description: Configure providers, BYOK keys, sync target. View is intentionally under-specified until the relevant concept actions exist.

TAP_MANAGE_PROVIDERS.label: Manage providers
TAP_MANAGE_PROVIDERS.description: User opens location-provider configuration to add a provider or change the default (LocationProvider.addProvider, LocationProvider.switchProvider).

LocationProvider.description: Configure which mapping services RTP uses to resolve Locations. List configured providers, add one (pasting a BYOK key when a provider requires it), and choose the default. Adding and switching are in-view concept actions (meta.actions); only BACK moves the user. See doc01.03 §5.
